body:
## Pull request overview

Adds internationalization (i18n) to the **plugin-detail** surface (DetailView/DetailSection/RelatedList) using the same “safe translation hook with English fallback” pattern used elsewhere in ObjectUI, and wires a new `detail` namespace into the i18n package/locales.

**Changes:**
- Introduces `useDetailTranslation` (with default English fallbacks) and applies it across DetailView/DetailSection/RelatedList.
- Adds `detail.*` strings to all locale bundles and registers `detail` as a built-in i18n namespace.
- Updates tests and ROADMAP to reflect the new i18n behavior and the empty-value placeholder change.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 20 out of 20 changed files in this pull request and generated 6 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/useDetailTranslation.ts | Adds reusable safe translation hook + default English `detail.*` fallback strings. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx | Exports the new translation utilities from the detail plugin entrypoint. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx | Replaces hardcoded UI strings with `t('detail.*')` translations. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx | Updates copy tooltip strings to i18n + changes empty/null display to styled em-dash. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx | Adds i18n for record counts/loading/empty states + adds optional New/View All header actions. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.test.tsx | Adds tests for RelatedList title/count/empty state and New/View All buttons. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/DetailView.test.tsx | Adds tests ensuring i18n fallback text renders without an I18nProvider. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/DetailSection.test.tsx | Updates assertions to match new empty value placeholder (`—`). |
| packages/i18n/src/useObjectLabel.ts | Registers `detail` as a built-in namespace key. |

The empty-value placeholder is hardcoded as an em-dash, but there is also a `detail.emptyValue` translation key in the new translation set that is currently unused. Either use `t('detail.emptyValue')` here to keep all UI text consistently driven by i18n, or remove the unused key from the defaults/locales to avoid dead translations. ```suggestion if (value === null || value === undefined) return {t('detail.emptyValue')}; ```

`createSafeTranslationHook` repeats the same fallback translator implementation in multiple branches. Extracting a small helper (like `createFallbackTranslator` in `packages/plugin-designer/src/hooks/useDesignerTranslation.ts`) would reduce duplication and make future changes less error-prone.

ROADMAP.md references `useSectionTranslation` for DetailSection tooltip i18n, but the implementation uses `useDetailTranslation` and there is no `useSectionTranslation` in the repo. Please update this line to match the actual hook name to avoid misleading documentation.
```suggestion
- [x] DetailSection copy tooltip i18n via `useDetailTranslation`
```

`handleDelete` now calls `t('detail.deleteConfirmation')`, but the `useCallback` dependency array for this handler does not include `t`. This can cause stale translations if the locale changes without unmounting. Add `t` to the dependency list (or compute the message outside the callback and depend on that).

`handleShare` uses `t('detail.details')` for the share title fallback, but the `useCallback` dependency array for this handler does not include `t`. Include `t` in the dependencies to avoid holding onto a stale translation function when locale changes.
